title: Design: price details for a line priced before tiers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'See Financial Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Use a work order on staging, work order 1, with a part line priced before the release.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at that part line's sell price.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens; the price has no icon.

Step 2:

  • A popover titled "Priced before tiers" shows Priced by "Before tiers", Cost, Sell price and Priced on, and reads "This part was priced before Tiered Pricing, so no tier or rule was recorded.", as in picture 12.5.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
